minors.issue: The spec says LoadFile errors never include the file's contents, but Parse validation errors, now prefixed with the path, quote the offending value from the file.
minors.scenario: agent.toml with `[update] channel = "nightly"` fails with `<path>: channel "nightly" is not stable or canary`, which echoes a value from the file. This is harmless because agent.toml holds no secrets, but the spec claims more than the code does.
